csv_scope_of_work: The City of Los Banos (City) will select qualified consulting firms to provide on-call planning consulting services. The consultant shall have the ability to provide in-house services, or the capacity to sublet for services associated with one or more proposed projects, including but not limited to: general planningrelated development and land use project review, site visits, environmental determinations, technical plan check for planning documents and plans, map review, conformance with Federal, State and local regulations, particularly the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) and general compliance with City Standards, Ordinances, and Regulations.
